settings.question: How do I choose my size?
settings.answer: Review the size guide and product notes. Contact client services for personal guidance before ordering.

settings.question: When will my order arrive?
settings.answer: Delivery timing and charges are calculated at checkout and depend on destination and product availability.

settings.question: Can I return or exchange an item?
settings.answer: Eligibility follows the store policy presented at checkout. Contact client services before sending an item back.

settings.question: How should I care for my piece?
settings.answer: Always follow the garment care label. Store clean and dry, away from direct sunlight.
